item.title: Iran threatens to end ceasefire over Hezbollah's exclusion from truce deal
item.summary: Iran says the U.S. must choose between ceasefire or war via Israel as Tuesday's ceasefire deal excludes Tehran-backed terrorist group Hezbollah.

item.title: UK's NATO show of force ends with docked destroyer in Mediterranean after 'technical' issue
item.summary: The U.K. docked its sole naval warship in the Mediterranean due to technical issues amid growing criticism of PM Starmer's response to the Iran war.

item.title: Evangelical leaders rally for Trump and Israel as Operation Epic Fury reshapes the region
item.summary: Evangelical leaders say support for Israel has remained strong during Operation Epic Fury, the joint U.S.-Israel military campaign against Iran, as a new ceasefire takes hold.

item.title: Iran's UN ambassador takes swipe at Trump in final hours before Strait of Hormuz deadline
item.summary: Iran's UN ambassador is calling one of President Donald Trump's posts on Truth Social on Tuesday “deeply irresponsible" and “profoundly alarming."

item.title: China aiding Iran missile program amid US-Israeli strikes, reports say
item.summary: China is reportedly sending missile fuel materials to Iran to help rebuild its missile program amid continuing U.S.-Israeli strikes aimed against the Tehran regime.

item.title: Russia, China veto UN resolution aimed at reopening Strait of Hormuz, hours before Trump deadline
item.summary: Russia and China vetoed a U.N. resolution to reopen the Strait of Hormuz hours before President Donald Trump's deadline for Iran to stop threatening the vital waterway.

item.title: US embassies in Bahrain, Egypt issue warnings as Iran threatens universities across Middle East
item.summary: The U.S. Embassy in Bahrain orders Americans to shelter in place, warning that Iran may target American universities in the country and across the Middle East.

item.title: 3 gunmen open fire outside Israeli consulate in Istanbul, dubbed 'terrorists' by Turkish official
item.summary: One attacker is dead and two others injured after a gunfight with police outside the Israeli consulate in Istanbul, Turkey's interior minister says.

item.title: Iran executes people, including teens, by hanging
item.summary: The nation of Iran has been carrying out executions, including of teenagers, as the U.S. and Israel wage war against the country, reports indicate.

item.title: IDF confirms IRGC intel chief killed; Quds Force commander also eliminated in strike
item.summary: Israel announces IRGC intelligence chief Majid Khademi was killed in a precision strike that also took out Quds Force special operations commander Bagheri.
